question: Is the remaining loss in extracting attributed country facts, or in realizing those facts in a short public statement?
initial_operation: One base shared-reader JSON map. Read all claims against sources before deciding writer pair.
writer_operation: If map is source-faithful, two base writers receive original card dossier plus complete unedited actual reader output. Same nine units/six guards/240 words. No handwritten fix, no optimization.
strong_control_limits: Adds an explicit field checklist, intermediate generation, source duplication and compute. Not an isolated staging-only effect, and not a persona/multi-agent benefit claim.
reader_review_gate: JSON/field parsing is software; source entailment requires complete same-assistant inspection. Uncertain claims are not silently repaired.
